features.name: Onboarding Service
features.description: Producers and distributors complete FBO attestation and onboarding, authenticated via an external-party identity provider, before they can trade on HarvestLink.

features.name: Compliance Documentation Service
features.description: Producers submit self-attested allergen declarations; drives the compliance-completeness score consumed by Discovery & Matching and Transaction Limit Enforcement.

criteria: FBO attestation must be explicitly confirmed before producer/distributor onboarding completes
Attestation records are retained for 6 years, segregated with extended lifecycle policies distinct from the standard 3-year transactional retention
Producer/distributor identity is authenticated via the external-party identity provider — Azure AD is employee-only and cannot be used
Onboarding requires cohort-eligibility confirmation from the Cohort Management Service before completing, since this is pilot-phase only
Allergen declaration requires producer_attestation before status transitions from pending to finalised
Compliance-completeness score is calculated from finalised declarations only
The finalised score is exposed to Discovery & Matching Service and Transaction Limit Enforcement Service
Declarations are stored independently within this service — no integration with the group's central Compliance Document Store, to preserve facilitation-only legal posture
